about: Livingstone, Zambia (id livingstone): the trunk road T1 (OSM way 23591193) from the south of Livingstone past the falls, over the old bridge across the gorge of the Zambezi (w22083857) and on along the trunk road on the far bank (Livingstone Way) (docs/proge/livingstone.md)
route: start on the trunk road south of Livingstone, southbound
near the falls park entrance and the border post
down towards the gorge, the eastern cataract 100-300 m to the north
the Zambian end of the old bridge
the far end of the bridge
finish on the trunk road on the far bank
